title: Electric field fluctuations and renormalization group flows in a self-interacting scalar field theory
summary: We consider a self interacting charged scalar field represented by the complex λφ4 model, embedded in a background electric field exhibiting classical stochastic fluctuations. We studied the effects of the classical stochastic noise on the physical parameters of the scalar field theory, for both weak and ultra strong electric field regimes.
